title: Retry quarantined Engram runtime teardown during project deletion
outcome: Project deletion currently decides whether runtime teardown is needed from the current project settings fingerprint. If a prior disable committed enabled=false but shutdown failed, a live quarantined runtime with an installed Engram descriptor can survive deletion without another teardown attempt. Derive deletion cleanup from installed runtime/quarantine state as well as settings.
acceptance: Deleting a project retries teardown for every affected live installed or quarantined Engram runtime even when settings are disabled; failed cleanup remains durable and visible; a disable-shutdown-failure then delete regression covers the path.
